gemini.title: Boundary Census Scotland Ethnicity Identity Language Religion I
gemini.abstract: Boundary Census Scotland Ethnicity Identity Language Religion I is an authoritative dataset published by National Records of Scotland. It represents boundary census scotland ethnicity identity language religion i features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by National Records of Scotland as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
